Method, coverage & interpretation

Decoded with the recovered LwBattleReport descriptor. This sample contains no unknown protobuf fields. English labels come from APK table version 39014 and locale 23521. The tables may not reflect the exact historical balance version of this battle.

Time is displayed as milliseconds / 1000, consistent with the 38343 totalTime value. Events are traversed by time, then recorded order, then original position. Phase codes remain numeric. Description placeholders remain visible where interpolation has not been validated.

Outgoing damage sums use damageDouble when explicitly present, otherwise damage. This is an inspection convention, not a verified precedence rule. Shield fields are shown verbatim; HP is not simulated. Missing proto3 scalar HP is zero; units with no starting HP are shown as unavailable.

Configuration matches: skills 90/90; buffs 67/67; action effects 65/65; attribute effects 220/239. Unresolved labels retain their IDs. An action log does not itself establish damage formulas or deterministic RNG.
